dataset: Proteins generated de novo (Proteus and FrameDiff checkpoints)
samples_recorded: 50 generated proteins at each of 5 lengths
protocols: All results are averages over 50 generated proteins at each of the lengths {100, 150, 200, 250, 300} for 500 timesteps; designability predicts a sequence with ProteinMPNN and refolds it with ESMFold, repeated 8 times keeping the sequence with the lowest scRMSD; temperature T = 1 for every SuperDiff variant; scores for translations and rotations are combined separately from both pre-trained models.
